actions.name: curve right in dim light (left wheel 40 %, right wheel 20 %)
stop when an obstacle is ahead
curve left on black (left wheel 10 %, right wheel 40 %)
curve right on no black (left wheel 40 %, right wheel 10 %)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, curve right; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Get through the tunnel, in the dark, and come out the other side.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: the light is below 70 %: it curves right
the light is not below 70 %: it goes to stopAtWall

decision_points.condition: the front obstacle sensor sees something ahead

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle ahead: it goes to followLine
the line tracker sees black: it curves left
the line tracker does not see black: it curves right

scenarios.coded_response: In bright light it follows the line: curve left on black, curve right on no black. Inside the tunnel it curves right at left wheel 40 % and right wheel 20 %.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line in bright light, before a tunnel that the line runs into, with nothing in front of it.
scenarios.trigger: It follows the line into the tunnel and the light falls below 70 %.
scenarios.title: Gets through the tunnel
assumptions: The tunnel is straight and the line runs through it: you didn't say its shape.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It gets through the tunnel and comes out the other side.

scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts in bright light with a wall close in front of it.
scenarios.trigger: The obstacle sensor sees the wall.
scenarios.title: Stops at a wall in bright light
assumptions: You didn't say it, but the stopAtWall part of your program means the robot should stop at walls.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It stops before the wall without bumping into it.

uncertainties: Your program curves right in dim light: it will probably bump into the side wall of a straight tunnel, and you didn't say the tunnel bends right.
